stages.headline: The line through a segment's midpoint perpendicular to it is the perpendicular bisector; each of its points is equally far from the ends.
stages.headlineEnglish: The line through a segment's midpoint perpendicular to it is the perpendicular bisector; each of its points is equally far from the ends.

stages.headline: Conversely, every point equally far from the ends of a segment lies on its perpendicular bisector.
stages.headlineEnglish: Conversely, every point equally far from the ends of a segment lies on its perpendicular bisector.

stages.headline: Each point of an angle bisector is equally far from the sides; conversely, an interior point equally far from the sides is on the bisector.
stages.headlineEnglish: Each point of an angle bisector is equally far from the sides; conversely, an interior point equally far from the sides is on the bisector.
